title: Generic UE configuration update completion by the network

entities.name: Generic UE configuration update completion
entities.description: Network procedure triggered upon receipt of CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMPLETE message where AMF processes updated parameters and performs necessary actions.

entities.name: CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMPLETE
entities.description: NAS message sent by UE to indicate completion of configuration update procedure.

entities.name: CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND
entities.description: NAS message sent by network to initiate configuration update procedure.

entities.name: T3555
entities.description: Timer used during configuration update procedure.

entities.name: Configuration update indication
entities.description: IE containing registration requested bit and other update indications.

entities.name: Registration requested condition
entities.description: Condition where registration requested bit is set in Configuration update indication IE.

entities.name: No emergency PDU session condition
entities.description: Condition where no emergency PDU session has been established for the UE.

entities.name: New parameters become valid
entities.description: Property where AMF considers new configuration parameters as valid and old ones as invalid.

entities.name: Release N1 NAS signalling connection
entities.description: Action where AMF initiates release of N1 NAS signalling connection.

relations.description: Procedure is triggered by receipt of CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMPLETE message.
Procedure stops timer T3555 upon receipt of CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMPLETE message.
CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message contains Configuration update indication IE.
Configuration update indication IE guards by registration requested condition.
Registration requested condition combined with other conditions establishes release of N1 NAS signalling connection.
No emergency PDU session condition guards the release of N1 NAS signalling connection.
CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND message establishes that new parameters become valid.
